questions.text: A and B can do a piece of work in 12 days and 12 days, respectively. Both work for 3 days and then A leaves. How long (in days) will B take to complete the remaining work?
A prize of ₹8,400 is to be shared between A and B in the ratio 3:5. Find B’s share.
The present age of a father is thrice that of his son. After 15 years, the age of the father will be twice that of his son. What is the present age ( in years) of the father?
A cylindrical water tank has a radius of 7 cm and a height of 10 cm. What is its volume? (Use π = 22/7)
The largest four-digit number which when divided by 14, 15 and 8 leaves remainder 4 in each case is:
A school drum beats every 12 minutes, and the school bell rings every 18 minutes. If both sounded together at 9:00 AM, how many times will they sound together again before 11:00 AM?
Girish scored 448 marks in an examination and was 81 marks short of 46% of maximum marks. In the same examination, his friend scored 805 marks. What is the percentage of marks scored by his friend?
The average of 6.5, 10.8, 20 and a is 15. The value of a is:5089

A cyclist travels from point A to B and back from B to A along the same route. On the onward journey, he covers one-third of the distance at 12 km/hr and the remaining distance at 18 km/hr. On the return journey, he covers half of the distance at 9 km/hr and the remaining distance at 18 km/hr. Find the average speed (in km/hr) for the entire round trip.
Two trains of lengths 120 m and 180 m are moving in the same direction at speeds of 60 km/h and 40 km/h, respectively. Find the time taken by the trains to cross each other.
The sum of the digits of a two-digit number is 11. If the digits are reversed, the new number is 27 more than the original number. What is the original number?
If one angle of an isosceles triangle is 110°, what are the measures of the other angles of the triangle?

A shopkeeper offers the following schemes on toys of the same marked price. (A) Successive discounts of 5% and 21% on any number of toys bought. (B) Successive discounts of 38%, 33% and 21% on any number of toys bought. (C) 8% discount on the first 6 toys and 27% discount on each toy thereon. (D) 3 toys free of cost on buying 7 toys. A customer wants to buy 7 toys. Which of the above schemes is the least beneficial to her?
A spherical tank has a radius of 2 meters. If the tank is filled with water to 80% of its total volume, what is the volume of water in the tank (rounded to the nearest cubic meter)?
A and B can do a piece of work in 12 days and 12 days, respectively. Both work for 3 days and then A leaves. How long (in days) will B take to complete the remaining work?

₹2,288 is divided among Pankaj, Meera, and Ashok in such a way that if ₹39, ₹47, and ₹40 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 17:15:14. Find Meera’s share after deduction.
What is the compound interest on ₹3,000 for 2 years at 20% per annum, interest compounded annually?

The following data shows the number of minutes taken by 15 students to complete a mathematics test: 42, 38, 55, 47, 50, 44, 60, 39, 48, 52, 45, 41, 49, 46, 53. Find the median time taken by the students.
A sum of money becomes ₹7,865 after 2 years and ₹8,651.50 after 3 years on compound interest at the same rate, compounded annually. Find the sum.

A wholesaler offers two options for a sofa set marked at ₹80,000: either a flat discount of 30% or two successive discounts of 20% and 12%. What is the difference in the selling price between the two options?

Seven people P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6 and P7 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre of the table. P7 sits second to right of P1. There are exactly two people between P1 and P6 when checked from right of P1. P2 is sitting immediately between P5 and P6. P3 sits second to right of P4. Who is sitting immediately between P6 and P3?

A town had a population of 5,000 at the beginning of a year. During the first year, the population decreased by 10%. In the following year, the population increased by 20%. What was the population of the town at the end of two years?

During a sale, 50% of the goods are sold at 12% profit, 40% of the remaining goods are sold at 16% profit and the still remaining goods are sold at a loss of 19%. If there is an overall profit of x%, then what is the value of x?
If one angle of an isosceles triangle is 110°, what are the measures of the other angles of the triangle?
Which of the following numbers is divisible by 7?

Two poles of heights 10 m and 30 m stand vertically on level ground at a distance d apart. From a point on the ground between them, along the line joining their feet, the angles of elevation to their tops of the taller and the shorter poles are 60∘ and 30∘, respectively. The distance d between the poles is: Ans A. B. C. D. Section : General Awareness
